specs.label: Specifications
specs.response: The neXus 60HE features adjustable magnetic switches, rapid trigger (0.1-4.0mm), and a full aluminum chassis.

not_connecting.label: Not connecting
not_connecting.response: Try reconnecting the braided USB-C cable directly to a motherboard port. Avoid unpowered hubs.

lighting_issues.label: Lighting issues
lighting_issues.response: Ensure RGB profiles aren't disabled in NexOS. You can reset lighting profiles using Fn + R.

firmware_updates.label: Firmware updates
firmware_updates.response: Firmware updates can be flashed directly from the NexOS software menu under Device Settings.

compatibility.label: Compatibility
compatibility.response: Compatible with Windows 10/11, macOS, Linux, PS5, and Xbox Series X/S.

cleaning.label: Cleaning rec.
cleaning.response: Use microfiber cloths and compressed air. Keycaps can be washed in warm soapy water.

keycaps.label: Replacing keycaps
keycaps.response: Standard MX-stem keycap sets are fully compatible with neXus switches.

installation.label: Installation
installation.response: Download the latest executable from our Downloads page and run as Administrator.

setup.label: Setup
setup.response: Launch NexOS with your keyboard plugged in to customize actuation curves and keybindings.

app_crashing.label: App crashing
app_crashing.response: Ensure graphics drivers are updated and check that anti-virus software isn't blocking NexOS background services.

keyboard_detect.label: Keyboard
keyboard_detect.response: Re-plug the USB cable while NexOS is running to force hardware re-detection.

profiles.label: Profiles
profiles.response: Profiles can be saved directly to onboard memory slots 1-4 via the Profile Manager.

release_notes.label: Release Notes
release_notes.response: Check our software updates log on the Downloads page for patch notes and bug fixes.

shipping_times.label: Shipping times
shipping_times.response: Standard shipping: 3-5 business days. Express shipping: 1-2 business days.

shipping_methods.label: Shipping methods
shipping_methods.response: We partner with DHL, FedEx, and UPS depending on your region.

payment_methods.label: Payment methods
payment_methods.response: We accept Visa, MasterCard, AMEX, PayPal, and Apple Pay.

coverage.label: Warranty coverage
coverage.response: All hardware comes with a 2-year limited manufacturer warranty covering factory defects.

return_refund.label: Return and refund
return_refund.response: 30-day money-back guarantee for unopened or defective products in original packaging.

replacement_parts.label: Replacement Parts
replacement_parts.response: Extra cables, switches, and keycap pullers are available in the Accessories section of our shop.

corporate_office.label: Corporate office
corporate_office.response: 8 Temasek Boulevard #29-02 Suntec Tower Three, Singapore.

social_media.label: Social media links
social_media.response: We have a YouTube and Twitch account!
